description: Fix dependencies, test coverage, build scripts, and deployment configuration for production readiness
steps: Update requirements.txt to pin all dependencies to specific versions for reproducible builds
Fix build_files.sh compatibility issues and add proper error handling for different environments
Expand test coverage in core/tests/ for critical model methods, views, and business logic
Add proper test database isolation and cleanup in test files
Create integration tests for user-facing features like contact forms and chat functionality
Review and validate database migration dependencies in core/migrations/
Optimize static file collection and WhiteNoise configuration in settings.py
Add database connection pooling and optimization for production deployments
acceptance_criteria: All dependencies are pinned to specific versions in requirements.txt
Build script works correctly on different deployment environments
Test coverage is comprehensive for all critical functionality
Tests run in isolation without interfering with each other
Static files are collected and served efficiently
Database migrations apply correctly in sequence
findings: Requirements.txt uses loose version constraints, build_files.sh has bash-specific syntax that may fail on some systems, test coverage appears limited based on investigation of test files, and static file configuration may need optimization for production.
